reviewDescription: I purchased this bra in size M in plum (the name of the hot pink colour.) I wear a 36C bra normally, and this sports bra fit me perfectly. The fabric is incredibly soft and comfortable. It has held up well to washing (no shrink, loss of shape, or issues with colour bleeding.) The reason I gave this bra only 3 stars is that it offers very little support, and the cups are not really appropriately sized. I was hoping for a running bra, but this is actually the least supportive of all of the bras and bralettes I own. I decided to keep it because of the low price, and the comfort level. It's great for wearing around the house. I wore it outside for gardening (I often just go bra-less), and it was perfect for that. I did remove the cups as they were wrinkled and far too small, forming bizarre circle shapes on my chest. If you need a budget-friendly, comfy, low support option with tons of stretch in a great neon colour, this is the bra for you.

What is the design of this sports bra, and how does it benefit me during workouts? 
The sports bra features a racerback design with wide shoulder straps, which evenly distribute weight across your shoulders. This reduces pressure points and provides added comfort and freedom of movement during your workouts.

This sports bra is great for activities like yoga, fitness training, running, and outdoor sports. It offers comfortable support for medium-intensity workouts but may not be ideal for very high-intensity exercises that require extra support.

We recommend hand washing or using a delicate cycle in a laundry bag to maintain the shape and elasticity. Always remove the padding before washing.
